intro.text: Earless Jaks, a bridgeman in Bridge Four who resents Kaladin's leadership.
Earless Jaks, a bridgeman in Bridge Four who came to respect Kaladin and helped paint the crew's carapace armor.
Earless Jaks, a bridgeman in Bridge Four who fell in the Battle of the Tower.

items.text: When Kaladin got the crew put on stone-gathering duty, Jaks and Dunny hauled a boulder over to the wagon on a sled. Jaks scowled at Kaladin and stalked off when complimented, and he joined Sigzil and Moash in mocking the bridgeleader during chasm duty.

After Kaladin showed his skill with a spear, Jaks questioned his plan to escape the warcamps but joined the training. When Leyten made armor from Parshendi carapaces, Jaks bought blue and white paint and decorated it.
Jaks was killed in the Battle of the Tower, along with Malop and Narm. Kaladin grieved that he couldn't save them.
Kaladin still remembered Jaks among the men he felt he had failed, both when trying to speak an Ideal and when Moash confronted him.

personality.text: At first openly hostile towards Kaladin, Jaks gradually came to respect him and became a willing member of the crew.
